traits.habitat_notes: A weed of fields, gardens, roadsides, lawns and parking lots, on moist to dry soils and sand; North America (probably native in the tropics, long naturalised northward), and widely as a weed elsewhere.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: a small flat mat of thin forking stems with whorls of narrow leaves and tiny white flowers on thread-like stalks.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species.

allometry.note: 0.05 m tall at 1 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a small flat mat of thin forking stems with whorls of narrow leaves and tiny white flowers on thread-like stalks.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=120942, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.life_span.note: English Wikipedia, 'Mollugo verticillata' (read 2026-10-19, lower trust): a rapidly spreading annual; FNA genus: herbs annual in the flora area.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): plants prostrate to ascending. Wikipedia: forms a prostrate circular mat. Flora of China: erect or diffuse.

traits.stem_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): plants 3-15(-45) cm, read as the length of the prostrate to ascending stems.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a prostrate mat whose tips and flower stalks rise only a few centimetres; FNA's 3-15 cm is stem length on the ground.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): herbs erect or diffuse, 10-30 cm; 30 cm only for erect plants.

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): stems to 45 cm at most, radiating from the root, so a mat up to about 90 cm across; derived by us from the stem length.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=120942, read 2026-10-19): stems branching from the base: many stems radiate from one root.

traits.stem_cross_section.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: slender, round stems; no source read says.

traits.stem_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: green, sometimes reddish-tinged stems; no source read names a colour.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=120942, read 2026-10-19): plants glabrous.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): leaves in whorls of 3-8 (FNA notes Holm's view that they are truly opposite pairs with clusters; Flora of China: false whorls of 3-7, or 2-3 on one side of a node).

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): leaves in whorls of 3-8; Flora of China 3-7.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): basal rosette present, sometimes disappearing as plant matures.

traits.leaf_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): leaf blades.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Molluginaceae (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=20193, read 2026-10-19): leaves simple (Flora of China family).

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): stem leaves oblanceolate or linear-oblanceolate; basal leaves obovate or obovate-spatulate. FNA: blade linear to elliptic, obovate or broadly spatulate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): apex obtuse to rounded or acute.

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): base cuneate (Flora of China: narrowly cuneate).

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Molluginaceae (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=20193, read 2026-10-19): blade margins entire.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=120942, read 2026-10-19): plants glabrous.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): blade 5-40 mm long; Flora of China stem leaves 1-3 cm, basal 1.5-2 cm; Wikipedia about 1-3 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): blade 0.5-15 mm wide (the wide end is the spatulate basal leaves); Flora of China stem leaves 1.5-4(-8) mm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): petiole 0.5-4 mm.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): leaves not glaucous (a plain green; Flora of China: yellowish green when dry); sRGB by eye for a fresh mid green.

traits.stipules.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=120942, read 2026-10-19): stipules absent or rudimentary.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): flowers 2-6 in sessile, axillary umbels; Flora of China: axillary umbellate clusters, 3-5-flowered.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): flowers 2-6 per umbel; Wikipedia 2-5; Flora of China 3-5.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): umbels sessile.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): umbels axillary, at the whorled nodes.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): pedicel 3-20 mm; Flora of China 3-5 mm, slender.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): pedicel erect-ascending at anthesis.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: five spreading tepals 1.5-3 mm long make an open flower about 4-5 mm across.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=120942, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals absent: a single whorl.

traits.perianth_parts.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): tepals 5, rarely 4.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): tepals 5, rarely 4.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): sepals oblong-elliptic, 1.5-2.5 x 0.5-1.2 mm, margins scarious; Flora of China tepals 2.5-3 mm.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): sepals white on the inner (upper) face; Flora of China: pale or greenish white; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.perianth_abaxial_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): sepals green on the outer face; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): stamens 3[-4], alternate with carpels; Flora of China (2 or)3(-5).

traits.carpels.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): ovary 3-loculed; styles 3.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): capsules.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): pericarp membranous, 3-valved.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): capsules ovoid-ellipsoid; Flora of China: ellipsoid or subglobose.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): capsules 2.5-3.3 mm long; Flora of China 3-4 mm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): capsules 1.4-2.2 mm wide; Flora of China ca. 2.5 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a thin membranous capsule, straw-coloured to pale greenish when ripe, half-wrapped by the persistent tepals; no source read names the colour.

traits.fruit_seed_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): seeds 15-35, dark or reddish brown with blackish curved ridges (Flora of China: chestnut-coloured, shiny); sRGB by eye for the words. Seeds 0.5-0.6 mm, below the vocabulary's seed_length_m range, so not set.

traits.fruit_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): pedicel erect to deflexed in fruit.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): persistent tepals surrounding more than half the capsule.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): flowering summer-early fall; Wikipedia: blooming July through September.

traits.fruiting_months.note: English Wikipedia, 'Mollugo verticillata' (read 2026-10-19, lower trust): flowers quickly turn into fruit; months from FNA's flowering season shifted by a month.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): 0-3000 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): 0-3000 m.

traits.light.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a weed of open, sunny disturbed ground (fields, gardens, roadsides).

traits.moisture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): moist to dry soils, sand.

traits.soil_texture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): weedy in fields and gardens, moist to dry soils, sand.

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Mollugo verticillata (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220008715, read 2026-10-19): weedy in fields, gardens, roadsides; Wikipedia adds parking lots; FNA discusses a likely New World tropical origin, with pre-Columbian seeds in Tennessee.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: stems 5-40 cm with whorls of 3-8 leaves a few cm apart.

traits.flowering_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: FNA: much-branched mats, flowers in the leaf whorls along the stems.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: FNA: 2-5 flowers on thread-like pedicels 5-15 mm from a node.
